prose: OpenAI has cut its valuation target to $1.25 trillion, down from the $1.4 trillion it pitched earlier this month, after resistance from some investors, the Financial Times reports - context for the up-to-$30B bridge round reported yesterday.
highlights: OpenAI cut its valuation target to $1.25T from $1.4T after investor resistance (FT)
The cut aligns with the up-to-$30B bridge round reported this week
